blocks.title: Sequence homology
blocks.text: Sequence homology DNA, RNA ya protein sequences ke darmiyan mushtarak (shared) nasab (ancestry) ki wajah se mushabahat (similarity) hai. Homologous sequences ek mushtarak ajdadi (ancestral) sequence se irtiqa pa kar bane hain.

Homologous sequences ki do bari qismein hain. Orthologs mukhtalif naslon (species) mein woh sequences hain jo speciation ke dauran ek mushtarak ajdadi gene se nikle; orthologs aksar naslon mein ek hi kaam barqarar rakhte hain. Paralogs ek hi nasl ke andar woh sequences hain jo gene duplication se nikle; paralogs naye kaam irtiqa kar sakte hain halanke woh ek hi ajdadi gene se nikle.

Sequence homology jandaron (organisms) ke darmiyan irtiqai (evolutionary) rishton ki basirat deti hai: homologous sequences ka muqabla kar ke scientists naslon ki irtiqai tareekh aur judai (divergence) ka andaza laga sakte hain. Yeh kisi anjaan gene ya protein ke kaam ka ishara bhi deti hai: agar anjaan gene ya protein kisi maloom kaam wale gene ya protein ka homologous ho to us ka kaam bhi ghaliban milta-julta hoga. Aur mukhtalif naslon mein beemariyon mein shamil homologous genes pehchanna beemari ke tareeqe samajhne aur ilaj banane mein madad deta hai, kyunke model jandaron ke homologous genes ko parh kar insani beemariyon ki basirat mil sakti hai.

blocks.title: Structural homology
blocks.text: Structural homology proteins ya doosre macromolecules ki teen-jehti (three-dimensional) banawat ke darmiyan mushtarak nasab ki wajah se mushabahat hai. Milti-julti banawat wale proteins aksar milte-julte kaam karte hain, chahe un ke sequences bohat milte na hon.

Protein ki teen-jehti banawat us ke kaam ke baare mein nihayat aham maloomat deti hai, is liye structural homology samajhna naye daryaft hone wale proteins ke kaam ki peshgoi mein madad deta hai. Yeh dawa ke design mein nihayat aham hai, kyunke dawaein aksar khaas protein banawaton se taalluq rakhne ke liye design hoti hain, aur proteins ke darmiyan banawati rishte samajhna zyada moassar dawaein design karne mein madad deta hai. Proteins ki structural homology parhna un irtiqai amal ko samajhne mein bhi madad deta hai jo proteins ke kaam aur taalluqat ko shakal dete hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: ek ajdadi gene speciation se nasl 1 ke gene A aur nasl 2 ke gene A mein bat-ta hai, jo orthologs likhi nuqtedar lakeer se jure hain; phir nasl 1 ka gene A duplicate ho kar gene A aur gene A prime banta hai, jo paralogs likhe hain. Daen: mukhtalif rang ke do proteins jin ke neeche mukhtalif huroof ke sequences hain magar andar ek hi ribbon fold, structural homology likha.
blocks.caption: Orthologs aur paralogs, aur structural homology (Figures 7.6 aur 7.7 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Orthologs mukhtalif naslon mein ek hi ajdadi gene ke roop hain, jo speciation se alag hue aur aam taur par ek hi kaam rakhte hain. Paralogs ek nasl ke andar gene duplication se bani gene ki copies hain, jo naye kaam irtiqa kar sakti hain. Structural homology ek mushtarak ajdad se mila teen-jehti fold hai; kaafi mukhtalif sequences wale do proteins fold aur is liye kaam share kar sakte hain. Banaye gaye sequences aur shaklein khaaka (schematic) hain.

blocks.caption: Sequence homology ka structural homology se muqabla
rows: Nucleotides ya amino acids ki tarteeb
Orthologs (naslon ke darmiyan, speciation se); paralogs (ek nasl ke andar, duplication se)
Mukhtalif sequences ke bawajood milti-julti banawat
Irtiqai tareekh; anjaan genes ka kaam; model jandaron mein beemari ke genes
Naye proteins ke kaam ki peshgoi; dawa ka design; protein ke kaam ka irtiqa

blocks.prompt: Do proteins apne amino acid sequence ka bohat thora hissa share karte hain magar ek hi shakal mein fold hote hain aur dono ek hi dawa se jurte hain. Kaun si qisam ki homology ise samjhati hai, aur yeh un ke kaam aur nasab ke baare mein kya batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Structural homology: un ke teen-jehti folds is liye milte hain ke woh ek mushtarak ajdadi protein se nikle hain, halanke un ke sequences alag ho gaye hain. Milti-julti banawat milte-julte kaam ka ishara hai, isi liye ek hi dawa dono mein fit hoti hai aur isi liye banawati rishte dawa ke design ki rehnumai karte hain.

items: Sequence homology mushtarak nasab se DNA, RNA ya protein sequences ki mushabahat hai: orthologs (mukhtalif naslein, speciation, ek hi kaam) aur paralogs (ek nasl, gene duplication, naye kaam pa sakte hain).
Yeh irtiqai rishte zahir karti hai, anjaan genes ke kaam ki peshgoi karti hai, aur model jandaron ke beemari ke genes ko insani beemari se jorti hai.

Structural homology mushtarak nasab se 3D banawat ki mushabahat hai; milti-julti banawat aam taur par milta-julta kaam, mukhtalif sequences ke bawajood. Yeh kaam ki peshgoi karti, dawa ke design ki rehnumai karti aur proteins ke irtiqa ka suraagh deti hai.
